units: Daily mean MW rounded to the integer, UTC day.
scope: Patch the 107 course dates on which all eight non-wind/non-solar generation categories were recorded as zero. Original course date keys, column names, fuel order and values on other dates are preserved. Recompute total as the exact sum of the 11 daily integer values. Demand, independent wind farm and market price are outside this repair.

provenance_test.replay_rule: From 2020-01-01 UTC, query the AGPT convenience endpoint with inclusive UTC midnight start/end, an end 366 days after start, then advance the next start by 367 days; cap the final query at 2026-09-17 00:00Z. Compare the returned one-row-per-date vectors directly with course CSV. Each of the 7 query endpoints is a midnight snapshot. Replay identifies likely endpoint and windows, but original extraction timestamp and underlying revision snapshot were not obtained.

repair.rule_2022_to_2025: Use FUELHH half-hour outturn means for the eight non-wind/non-solar categories. Preserve the original three renewable columns except 2023-01-05, where the course value was a midnight snapshot; recover all three renewable means from 48 AGPT observations. On 2025-03-11, replace three simultaneous zero or near-zero FUELHH intervals (10:30, 11:00, 11:30 UTC) with linear interpolation between the intact 10:00 and 12:00 intervals, after verifying contemporaneous gas and nuclear against NESO.
repair.rule_2026: Use all eleven current AGPT daily values on 23 dates with 48 subdaily readings and exact agreement between the rounded mean and the official daily output. On 13, 19 and 26 July (45, 38 and 35 AGPT observations respectively), use 48 FUELHH readings for the eight categories and preserve the course values for the three renewables.
repair.note: Exclude interconnectors and do not combine FUELHH WIND or NESO totals with course renewable columns. For net pumped storage count positive half-hour output only. Gross output versus net metering and other coverage differences can remain. Imports and the independent wind farm are not part of the generation patch.

validation.selection: Normal candidates in sampled two-day windows every other month and up to four days from flagged dates; exclude the 107, replay end dates, and dates whose current AGPT daily vector differs from course. Require 48 half-hours, complete eight-fuel AGPT and FUELHH records, positive AGPT gas and nuclear throughout, and no identified FUELHH outage slots. All 92 clean controls reproduce the daily eight-fuel course vector from AGPT half-hour averages.
confirmed_extra_partial_zero_dates_colum: FUELHH-based eight-fuel daily sum minus course eight-fuel daily sum (MW), indicative
validation.limits: Control errors are empirical and do not bound the true error on missing dates. Partial-zero list is from sampled controls. Six midnight-boundary dates outside the 107 and 61 2026 AGPT differences outside the 107 remain outside the patch. The 31 missing dates remain absent.

output_verification.supply_demand_comparison_definition: Use the intersection of supplied generation, demand, independent wind farm and price. Supply is the given generation plus the separate wind farm. The sum of positive or negative daily differences multiplied by 24 h is an illustrative model quantity.
